description: Project decision retrieval is ordered by the decision date across sessions; proposals never become accepted decisions.

messages.content: At 2026-09-15T11:00:00Z, project Orion decided to use a durable queue for background jobs. This is an accepted design decision, not a claim that it is deployed.

Historical note for project Orion: at 2026-09-12T09:00:00Z we decided to prototype background jobs inline. I am reporting that older decision today. A move to distributed workers is only a proposal for next week; it has not been decided or deployed.
